name: smartwallet-cd
description: Einnahmen-Ausgaben-Dashboard für Paare – Cloudflare Worker + Hono + D1

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute smartwallet-cd-db --local --file=./scripts/d1-baseline-migrations.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply smartwallet-cd-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute smartwallet-cd-db --remote --file=./scripts/d1-baseline-migrations.sql && wrangler d1 migrations apply smartwallet-cd-db --remote
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute smartwallet-cd-db --local --file=./scripts/reset.sql && npm run db:init
